title: The rise of AI-first enterprises: What CIOs should prioritize in 2026
summary: As enterprises transition to AI-first operations, they are revamping workflows and harnessing capabilities centered around artificial intelligence. To implement AI responsibly, CIOs must establish robust data and technology frameworks. The rise of autonomous AI agents underscores the necessity for effective governance and workforce preparedness. Embracing agentic AI requires a reassessment of human-AI interaction and job functions, with a focus on measuring success through business outcomes rather than mere adoption.
